data.name: AppTitle
data.comment: Window title. "N1MM" and "DXKeeper" are product names - do not translate.

data.name: SettingsHeader
data.comment: Heading of the settings section.

data.name: NetworkHeader
data.comment: Heading of the card holding ports and the multicast group.

data.name: ServicesHeader
data.comment: Heading of the card holding what DXKeeper should do with each logged QSO.

data.name: DiagnosticsHeader
data.comment: Heading of the card holding logging options.

data.name: LogCopy
data.comment: Button copying the visible operation log to the clipboard.

data.name: LogClear
data.comment: Button clearing the on-screen operation log. Does not affect ErrorLog.txt.

data.name: LogCopyTip
data.value: Copy the operation log to the clipboard

data.name: LogClearTip
data.value: Clear the on-screen log. ErrorLog.txt is not affected.

data.name: LogCopied
data.value: Operation log copied to the clipboard ({0} lines).
data.comment: {0} is a line count.

data.name: FailedQsoBarTitle
data.comment: Title of the warning bar shown when DXKeeper did not confirm one or more QSOs.

data.name: FailedQsoBarMessage
data.value: {0} QSOs from this session could not be delivered to DXKeeper. Import {1} into DXKeeper, then delete it — this notice clears when the file is gone.
data.comment: {0} is a count, {1} is a filename. Do not translate the filename.

data.name: FailedQsoBarMessageOne
data.value: 1 QSO from this session could not be delivered to DXKeeper. Import {0} into DXKeeper, then delete it — this notice clears when the file is gone.
data.comment: Singular form. {0} is a filename. Do not translate the filename.

data.name: UdpPortLabel
data.comment: Label for the port N1MM broadcasts QSO data to. "UDP" is a protocol name - do not translate.

data.name: UdpPortTip
data.value: UDP port that N1MM Logger+ broadcasts QSO XML to (default 12060)
data.comment: Tooltip. Keep "N1MM Logger+", "UDP", "QSO" and "XML" in English.

data.name: MulticastLabel
data.comment: Label for an optional IPv4 multicast group address.

data.name: MulticastPlaceholder
data.comment: Placeholder shown inside the empty multicast text box.

data.name: MulticastTip
data.value: Optional. Leave blank unless the sending program is configured to send to a multicast group (224.0.0.0 - 239.255.255.255). Unicast and broadcast are received either way. The group is joined on the interface the routing table selects.
data.comment: Tooltip. Do not translate the address range.

data.name: DxKeeperPortLabel
data.comment: Label. "DXKeeper" and "TCP" - do not translate.

data.name: DxKeeperPortTip
data.value: Read-only here. Set it in DXKeeper: {0}. The gateway sends to Base Port + 1, which is the port DXKeeper shows in that panel's heading.
data.comment: Tooltip. {0} is the English menu path inside DXKeeper (DxKeeperConfigPath) and must stay untranslated, because DXKeeper's own interface is English-only.

data.name: DxKeeperConfigPath
data.value: Config > Defaults tab > Network Service > Base Port
data.comment: DO NOT TRANSLATE. A literal menu path inside DXKeeper, whose interface is English-only. Translating it would describe a menu that does not exist.

data.name: DxKeeperPortReading
data.comment: Placeholder shown until DXKeeper's configured port has been read.

data.name: StatusHeader
data.comment: Heading of the section showing whether each DXLab program is reachable.

data.name: LogHeader
data.comment: Heading of the running list of what the gateway has done.

data.name: SeeErrorLog
data.comment: Link shown when something has been written to the error log. "ErrorLog" is the filename ErrorLog.txt - do not translate.

data.name: DisplayErrorLog
data.comment: Button that opens ErrorLog.txt.

data.name: CheckDxkLookup
data.comment: "QSO" means a radio contact and is used in English worldwide - do not translate.

data.name: CheckDxkLookupTip
data.value: Direct DXKeeper to display previous QSOs with the logged callsign

data.name: CheckCallbook
data.comment: A callbook is a database of licensed operators.

data.name: CheckCallbookTip
data.value: Direct DXKeeper to query its selected callbook

data.name: CheckEqsl
data.comment: "eQSL.cc" is a website name - do not translate.

data.name: CheckEqslTip
data.value: Direct DXKeeper to upload logged QSO to eQSL.cc

data.name: CheckLotw
data.comment: "LoTW" is the ARRL's Logbook of the World - do not translate.

data.name: CheckLotwTip
data.value: Direct DXKeeper to upload logged QSO to LoTW

data.name: CheckClubLog
data.comment: "Club Log" is a website name - do not translate.

data.name: CheckClubLogTip
data.value: Direct DXKeeper to upload logged QSO to Club Log

data.name: CheckVerboseLoggingTip
data.value: Show low-priority status events in the operation log (e.g. DDE connect/disconnect)
data.comment: "DDE" is a Windows protocol name - do not translate.

data.name: FailedQsoCount
data.comment: Status line. {0} is a count. Followed by links reading "file" and "folder". See FailedQsoCountOne for the singular.

data.name: FailedQsoCountOne
data.comment: Singular form of FailedQsoCount. Languages with more plural forms may need extra keys.

data.name: FailedQsoOpenFile
data.comment: Link that opens the failed-QSO ADIF file.

data.name: FailedQsoOpenFolder
data.comment: Link that shows the failed-QSO file in Explorer.

data.name: FailedQsoTip
data.value: Import {0} into DXKeeper, then delete it. This count clears when the file is gone.
data.comment: Tooltip. {0} is the full path of the ADIF file - do not translate it.
